case.target_source: the certificate of a concrete in-domain input (every lane at the domain's upper bound); the builder solves for a target and requires the selected output to equal it, so an unreachable target reports UNSAT for a program that is admitted

paired.reading: the same computation with the counted loop keeps one scf.for in TTIR and TTGIR and one branch cycle in LLIR and PTX; the mechanically unrolled form of the same program has neither, and both produce the identical complete output on the device

unrolled.construction: test.lib.tensor_unrolled_companion.build_companion: the counted case's program is unrolled, the Triton kernel is re-emitted for the straight-line program, and the reference is the interpreter replay of the unrolled program over the counted inputs, which must equal the counted expected.bin at 128 and 256 reference bits
